title: RenderPlan
description: Output of the Render Specification Generator: the complete, engine-agnostic RenderSpec list for a project, gated behind human approval (gate 2, 'final scene planning') before any Video Engine Adapter is invoked. Mirrors the same draft/pending_review/approved/changes_requested lifecycle as Storyboard (gate 1).

director_plan_version.description: Must match the Storyboard this plan was compiled from, so an approval can't be silently applied to a since-revised plan.

engine_id.description: Which engine's CapabilityManifest this plan was compiled against (e.g. 'wan2.1'). Set by the Render Specification Generator, never chosen by any upstream Planner.
